operations.title: The prior proposed identification of G24 quadratic F_{2,1} pseudo-fluxes with FPR's explicitly cubic collinear block is degree-mistyped and withdrawn.
Quadratic F_{2,1} pseudo-fluxes must map to the hard/renormalized-aspect sector or remain unmatched; only cubic F_{2,0} is degree-compatible with the FPR collinear block.
Exact rung-3 memory checker passes 51/51 and enforces nonlinear degree separation.
